DI_tm_building_gfx_reset_building_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = gfx_reset_building }
                    }
                    add_building = gfx_reset_building
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                        NOT = { has_building = monastery_02 }

                    add_building = monastery_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = monastery_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = monastery_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = monastery_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = monastery_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            }

DI_tm_building_settlement_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = settlement_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = settlement_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = settlement_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = settlement_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = settlement_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = settlement_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = settlement_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = settlement_03
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_settlement_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = settlement_03 } remove_building = settlement_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = settlement_02 } remove_building = settlement_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = settlement_01 } remove_building = settlement_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_the_red_keep_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_red_keep_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_red_keep_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_red_keep_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_red_keep_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_red_keep_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_red_keep_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_red_keep_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_red_keep_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_red_keep_03
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_the_red_keep_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = the_red_keep_03 } remove_building = the_red_keep_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = the_red_keep_02 } remove_building = the_red_keep_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = the_red_keep_01 } remove_building = the_red_keep_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = agot_taelas_gap_01 } remove_building = agot_taelas_gap_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_agot_naeros_irrigation_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = agot_naeros_irrigation_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = agot_naeros_irrigation_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = agot_naeros_irrigation_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = agot_crones_steps_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = agot_crones_steps_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = agot_crones_steps_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = agot_wrecks_of_dagger_lake_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = agot_wrecks_of_dagger_lake_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = agot_wrecks_of_dagger_lake_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    add_special_building = agot_ruins_of_oldforge_01

                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = agot_ruins_of_oldforge_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = agot_ruins_of_oldforge_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = agot_ruins_of_oldforge_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = agot_ruins_of_oldforge_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = agot_ruins_of_oldforge_01

                    add_special_building = agot_widows_watch_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = agot_widows_watch_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = agot_widows_watch_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = agot_widows_watch_03
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = agot_sharp_point_beacon_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = agot_sharp_point_beacon_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = agot_sharp_point_beacon_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_generic_copper_mines_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = generic_copper_mines_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = generic_copper_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = generic_copper_mines_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = generic_copper_mines_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = generic_copper_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = generic_copper_mines_02
                }
                else_if = {

DI_tm_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = church_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = temple_04 } remove_building = temple_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_03 } remove_building = temple_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_02 } remove_building = temple_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_01 } remove_building = temple_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = stilted_granaries_01 }

                    add_building = stilted_granaries_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = stilted_granaries_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = stilted_granaries_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }

                    add_building = stilted_granaries_03

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_citadel_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
